name: nodebeacon
description: Self-hosted node monitoring and uptime dashboard powered by Prometheus.

scripts.build: pnpm -r build && npm --prefix apps/status-web ci && npm --prefix apps/status-web run build && npm --prefix apps/status-web run scan:forbidden && node scripts/assemble-web.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && npm --prefix apps/status-web ci && npm --prefix apps/status-web exec -- tsc -b apps/status-web/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && npm --prefix apps/status-web ci && npm --prefix apps/status-web run lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @nodebeacon/shared build && pnpm -r test && npm --prefix apps/status-web test
